description:
In this deep-dive episode of “I’d Like to Know”, Pastors Stephen Bohr, C.A. Murray, and David Salazar answer two powerful questions that bridge creation, prophecy, and the sanctuary message.

Questions:

00:00 Intro
02:20 – Why did God ask Adam and Eve to tend a perfect Garden?
11:35 – Is Daniel 8 really about Greece and the earthly sanctuary?
A viewer challenges the traditional SDA interpretation of Daniel 8:14 and the 2300 days. Why do Adventists believe the “sanctuary” refers to the heavenly one? Why interpret the 2300 evenings and mornings as years, not literal days? Wasn’t Jesus affirming the Jewish temple in John 10:22?

📖 This episode defends foundational truths about the heavenly sanctuary, the prophetic timeline, and God’s design for creation.

📅 New episodes every Tuesday at 4 PM PT on SUMtv.

💬 Got questions? Ask in the comments — we’d love to hear from you!
